scope: Writing and reading help work again. First letters go round every list. Email says Re: for replies. Companion links your Chrome again when the link drops.

topics.title: First letters go round
details: In every list, a first letter now goes round to the top after the last match.
This works in menus, email folders, file lists, and the other lists.
The arrows, Home and End still stop at the start and end of a list.
If only one item starts with that letter, you hear it again.

topics.title: Replies say Re:
details: In Thunderbird email, a reply in a thread now says Re: before its subject.
Companion updates its Thunderbird add-on for this. Thunderbird may restart once by itself.

topics.title: Writing and reading help
details: Writing help works again. So do summarise and simplify.
Before, every request said the AI assistant could not do that just now.
If a request fails, Companion now writes the reason in ai-error.txt in its settings folder. Your words are never written there.

topics.title: Your Chrome
details: If the link to your Chrome drops, Companion opens Chrome or links it again.
Before, it said it would reconnect by itself, even when Chrome was closed.
If Chrome cannot be reached, you hear that. Check that Chrome is open, then try again.

topics.title: Tutorial
details: In the YouTube lesson, Left and Right Arrow move back and forward in the practice video again.
